review_type: Read-only static code and existing calibration metadata review. No source extraction or renderer execution; no reserved/arc image opened.

findings.evidence: runtime.resume now compares sealed result method_hashes to method_hashes() of current essential Python and mesh_raster.cpp files. runtime.seal records that same manifest.
findings.limit: No intentional code mutation performed against live production to test rejection.

findings.evidence: run.main requires code_binding.cpu_native_py_sha256 equal current cpu_native.py SHA256. All four construction calibration JSON bindings match current file and status PASS. The embedded renderer CPP is part of that Python file.
fusion_arm validates each extraction seal; build_arm validates fusion seal; seal_scene validates DEV selection seal.
findings.residual: build_arm additionally consumes raw alpha caches without checking their source/rgb seals at that point; asset footprint evaluation reads region_provenance NPZ not included in the asset seal. An independent final traversal of all stage seals/inputs remains necessary for complete provenance consistency. No tampering or inconsistent artifact was observed.

findings.evidence: Primary vertex_anchor_ids now identify the owner of nearest retained raw occupied voxel. Nearest-center IDs are separately retained. Mahalanobis/displacement use primary owner.
findings.limit: This is a local support witness, not proof every extracted/fill vertex lies inside its original Gaussian ellipsoid. Marching-cubes and declared closing add displacement; owner is one winner rather than the exhaustive overlapping support set.

findings.evidence: evaluate_view uses final region retained_owner_ids and labels the native-footprint panel accordingly, replacing broader fusion selected_ids.
findings.limit: Fusion PLY still represents candidate support; final region-owner IDs are separately stored. Both counts should be reported.

findings.evidence: control_limit explicitly records simultaneous support, source silhouette constraints and bbox-spacing differences; this is a pipeline source-count comparison.
fusion.rim_used explicitly states 3px wide map used; 1.5px map diagnostic only.
Final axes are score-dependent with truncation and minimum voxel axis. width_world_floor remains a storage key for covariance inflation, not actual final radius. REPORT_METHODS_ZH.md spells this out.
Construction foreground constraints occur once in object space; evaluation remains fixed mesh self-zbuffer, x-ray relative to the original opaque object.

judgment: Reviewed fixes address the reported immediate code-version/calibration/direct-input gaps. No basis found to halt the current ordered production run. Full end-to-end seal verification and visual evaluation remain pending; this is not a scientific GO.
